transformation: Bundle each source table's Hf(298.15 K), H(T)-H(298.15 K), and S(T) columns. Runtime apparent G(T) = Hf(298.15 K) + [H(T)-H(298.15 K)] - T*S(T), converting kJ/mol enthalpies and J/(mol K) entropy to J/mol. Interpolate source enthalpy increment and entropy separately, linearly. Also retain finite enthalpy-increment/entropy columns from identified transition lines in parse_ambiguities and use the crystal-liquid row at its inclusive cap instead of interpolation.
source_span_rule: Finite source enthalpy-increment and entropy nodes; evaluation starts at 298.15 K.
phase_restriction_rule: A JANAF crystal is valid through its crystal-to-liquid transition temperature, inclusive; never evaluate it above that transition.
